phase_prompt.summary: Standard operating configuration; chrome and blue hard-light.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A full body shot of the Angel, a geometric construct of chrome and blue light. The figure is an industrial abstraction of a seraph, with floating metal segments suspended in a blue energy field. The surrounding environment is reflected in its polished surfaces. It emits a steady, calm blue glow. High-tech sci-fi aesthetic fused with ancient religious grandeur. Volumetric lighting, sharp focus, hyper-detailed textures.
